name: Felt
author: E. T. Carter
description: A sheet of dyed wool felt under a raking lamp: a mat of short kinked fibres with a soft directional nap that goes dark where the pile lies toward the light and pale where it lies away. A slow hand-stroke crosses the sheet and lays the pile over in its wake, while low folds give the cloth a matte relief and the dye sits in soft wet-felted patches of the palette.

params.label: Pile
params.effect: Visibility of the fibre pile and its self-shadow; 0 is a smooth pressed board, high is a hairy fleece.

params.label: Nap contrast
params.effect: Tonal shift between pile lying toward and away from the lamp; the strength of the brushed band.

params.label: Stroke speed
params.effect: How fast the hand-stroke crosses the sheet and the folds creep; 0 holds the nap still.

params.label: Folds
params.effect: Relief of the soft folds in the sheet under the raking light; 0 lays it perfectly flat.

params.label: Fibre length
params.effect: Length of the fibres in CSS pixels; low is a fine dense mat, high is coarse long-staple wool.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer combs the nap around it; 0 ignores the mouse.
